title: Budget: 100 queries, huge array
prompt:
**Tình huống.** n ≤ 100000 numbers. q ≤ 100 queries; each asks the median of a range [l, r].

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Build a segment tree answering medians

**B)** For each query, copy the range, sort, take the middle (O(q · n log n) total)

**C)** Prefix sums of medians

**D)** DSU over values

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: q = 100 makes O(q · n log n) ≈ 1.7·10^8 fit comfortably; a persistent/wavelet structure is the online answer but is pure overengineering at q = 100.
